items.title: Earnings live updates: Salesforce, CrowdStrike, Okta stocks soar as AI boom helps lift Q2 results
items.summary: The second quarter earnings season is nearly complete. Nvidia's Q2 results on Wednesday served as a keystone to a remarkably strong stretch of corporate reports.

items.title: Why Nvidia is still a buy after earnings
items.summary: Laffer Tengler Investments CEO & CIO Nancy Tengler joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down what Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings say about the chipmaker's outlook and why she remains bullish on the stock. "I don't know what to find wrong with the report," Tengler says.

items.title: The US is holding itself back in AI race as admin. weighs semiconductor tariffs
items.summary: The Trump administration is weighing options for a new round of tariffs on semiconductors, according to POLITICO reporting. Morning Brief Host Jake Conley is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and AInvest managing editor Adam Shapiro to discuss how the US may be holding itself back in the AI race with these trade policies.

items.title: Earnings spur software and chip rally, offsetting weakness in other areas of the market: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Software stocks gained after Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff said the SaaSpocalypse was over.

items.title: Why Nvidia probably just lit a new fire under these once-hot trades
items.summary: Nvidia has struck an ultra bullish tone on memory chips.

items.title: Why Nvidia says its AI partnerships aren't 'circular financing'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) delivered another blockbuster quarter, beating Wall Street's expectations as demand for AI infrastructure continues to surge. But amid growing scrutiny over Nvidia's investments in AI companies and data-center projects, questions about "circular financing" have taken center stage. On Nvidia's earnings call, CFO Colette Kress pushed back on that characterization, explaining why the chipmaker views its partnerships and investments as strategic opportunities, not simply a way to finance.

items.title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: AI's next big bottleneck isn't infrastructure. It's regulatory red tape.
items.summary: Resistance to data center development and AI regulation is taking center stage in politics ahead of the midterm elections. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley joins Market Domination's Josh Lipton to break down the growing demand for industry oversight and which state is seeing a surprise pushback against data center construction.
